tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use Rustls as the TLS backend, because it fits the Rust codebase, has fewer CVEs, and is simpler. Related standing decisions are that all traffic uses HTTPS with no plaintext exception, now that certificate management is in place, and that testing uses self-signed certificates.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
